summary: A structured, version-controlled workspace for engineering CAD laboratory assignments, integrating 3D modeling, 2D drafting, and AI-optimized development workflows.
technologies: AI Assistants (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code)
key_features: Centralized Git repository for CAD binaries (.ipt, .dwg)
AI context management via .aiignore to prevent token limit exhaustion
Manual version tracking and rollback system
achievements: Architected a Git-based workflow specifically optimized for large binary CAD files, solving version control challenges through manual timestamped backups and AI context exclusion rules. Configured cross-platform repository settings to eliminate diff noise and established strict guidelines for handling temporary files, software version compatibility, and documentation exports. Designed a scalable migration strategy to Git LFS for long-term performance and documented best practices for AI-assisted engineering workflows.
